title: Multi-Language Coverage, Complexity & Duplication Baseline

java.test_class_exclusion: *Test.java and *Tests.java are excluded from the production denominator because System Master intentionally compiles many qualification tests as main classes

acceptance: Bind every report to the exact workflow subject SHA.
Produce Java line/branch/method/complexity coverage after executing the current Maven qualification bridge.
Produce Python line and branch coverage over declared production roots with never-executed source retained in the denominator.
Produce JavaScript line/branch/function/statement coverage with --all over declared production roots.
Continue report collection after an individual test or qualification failure when technically possible, preserving that failure in execution-health evidence.
Do not convert a failing test into a green baseline; zero unresolved execution failures are required for PQF-001F admission.
Produce cross-language function-level structural complexity measurements.
Produce cross-language exact/mild clone statistics and clone locations.
Emit pinned tool versions and SHA-256 digests for raw reports.
Emit one machine-readable PQF-001F baseline receipt.
Rerun the dedicated baseline on the exact post-merge main SHA before treating the baseline as authoritative.
Do not enforce any coverage, complexity, density, parameter-count, or duplication threshold.
Do not refactor or otherwise mutate production source in order to improve the baseline.
successor_gate: PQF-001G may begin only after PQF-001F has a complete exact-subject receipt with zero unresolved execution failures or every cross-owner execution finding has been repaired and requalified.
successor_after_numeric_baseline: PQF-001G — STATIC ANALYSIS, SECURITY & SUPPLY-CHAIN BASELINE
